podcast.title: Band Formation and Breakup (1989-1994)
podcast.body: School of Fish was a four-piece band from Los Angeles that was active from 1989 to 1994, releasing a couple of albums during this period. "School of Fish, a four-piece LA band with a couple of albums, but only one hit when they were together from 1989 until 1994."

podcast.title: Singer's Solo Career and Death (2000)
podcast.body: After the band disbanded, singer Josh Clayton Felt pursued a solo career, releasing two albums. He was diagnosed with cancer in 1999 and tragically passed away the following year at the age of 32. "The singer Josh Clayton Felt went solo and released a couple of albums, but then he was diagnosed with cancer in 1999 and he died the following year at the age of 32."

podcast.title: Chad Fisher's Continuing Work
podcast.body: Chad Fisher went on to form a group called Laslo Bain, which is recognized for writing the theme song for the TV show Scrubs. He continues to work as a composer and producer. "And Chad Fisher formed a group called Laslo Bain, which is the band who wrote the theme song for the TV show Scrubs and he continues to work as a composer and producer."

podcast.title: Formation and Ahead-of-its-Time Sound
podcast.body: School of Fish formed in Los Angeles in 1990. Their debut album, released in April 1991, showcased a grinding guitar style that predated the major alt-rock and grunge boom of the 90s. They were considered about a year ahead of their time, releasing their debut before Nirvana, Pearl Jam, Smashing Pumpkins, and Soundgarden had released their defining albums. "School of Fish was formed in Los Angeles in 1990 and had a debut album in stories by April 1991."

podcast.title: Guitarist Michael Ward's Subsequent Career
podcast.body: Guitarist Michael Ward later became a member of The Wallflowers and joined Ben Harper's band, The Innocent Criminals. He also diversified his creative endeavors by writing children's books. "Guitarist Michael Ward eventually became a member of the Wallflowers and part of Ben Harper's band The Innocent Criminals. He also wrote some children's book."

podcast.title: Josh Clayton Feltz's Tragic Death
podcast.body: Josh Clayton Feltz, the singer for School of Fish, pursued a solo career after the band's breakup but tragically died in 1999 from a very aggressive form of testicular cancer. "And singer Josh Clayton Feltz went solo before dying of a very aggressive sort of districular cancer in 1999."

podcast.title: Post-Breakup Careers
podcast.body: Following the commercial failure of their second album and subsequent breakup, the members of School of Fish pursued separate careers. One member went on to play with The Wallflowers and Ben Harper, another wrote the theme song for the TV show *Scrubs*, and singer Josh Clayton Feltz embarked on a solo career. "The band broke up with everybody going their separate ways."
